name: xpense-web
description: The friends' web link page (docs/server.md section 7). Static files for Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.preview: node build.mjs && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler pages dev dist --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788
scripts.deploy: node build.mjs --production --deploy && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "$PAGES_PROJECT" --branch main
